Reproducibility of the OFV

pk_repro.Rd

Re-estimates a model with different SAEM seeds and/or from randomly perturbed initial estimates (with FOCEI only). The OFV of the same population model should be reproducible within a few points; larger differences point to local minima or multimodal individual likelihoods. The runs are regular ledger runs (stage "repro") with the original run as parent.

Usage

pk_repro(
  run,
  seeds = c(7, 99),
  perturb_starts = 0,
  perturb_sd = 0.3,
  seed = 1,
  data = NULL,
  fit_fun = NULL,
  quiet = FALSE,
  proj = NULL
)

Arguments

run

A completed run (reference or id).

seeds

SAEM seeds for repeated SAEM-based estimations (the seed of the original run is skipped).

perturb_starts

Number of FOCEI fits from perturbed initial estimates.

perturb_sd

Standard deviation of the log-normal perturbation of the structural parameters.

seed

Seed for the perturbation.

data, fit_fun, quiet, proj

See pk_run().

Value

A tibble with the columns label, method, run_id, ofv and the estimates; the attribute ofv_range holds the range of the OFV across the original and the repeated runs.
